title: Samsung Note10 Plus problems
symptom: Samsung Note 10 Plus stops receiving data from G6 after a few readings. After restarting the collector, it works again for a few readings. On the G6 status, the phone service stats is "Scanning xx:xx", and the Bluetooth Link stays in connecting.
fix: Changing the setting 'Glose GATT on BLE disconnect' to ON resolved the issue for one user, achieving 100% capture. Another user also cleared a battery warning in the Dexcom app, but the main fix is the setting change.
settings_changed: Glose GATT on BLE disconnect → ON
evidence_quote: Currently have 100% capture by changing this setting: Glose GATT on BLE disconnect - ON
